THE MAN BEHIND THE MERRY

Meet Santa.
Meet High Def.

Hoover Doss, Jr. grew up in Magnolia, Arkansas. His initials inspired the name “High Def.” His path led him from service in the Army to service in the classroom, teaching and encouraging young people.

In 2022, his love for Christmas, children, families, and community representation became Santa In High Def. As a Black Santa, he brings representation and a welcoming presence to holiday celebrations.

His signature look includes a real beard and a full rustic, woodsman-style costume. His mobile Santa chair brings a familiar setting to the visit.

Army retireeEducatorSanta since 2022

BEFORE SANTA ARRIVES
A few helpful answers.
How do I book Santa In High Def?
Complete the request form and send your request. We’ll follow up to confirm availability, pricing, and arrangements. Your date is not reserved until you receive booking confirmation.
What does a visit cost?
Send your event location, date, and visit length to Santa to discuss pricing. This website does not collect payment.
Does Santa bring his own chair?
Santa In High Def brings a mobile Santa chair. Discuss the chair, setup space, and access to your venue when arranging your visit.
Does Santa travel to my location?
Santa In High Def lists Round Rock, Texas as his location. Include your city and venue in your request so Santa can confirm travel arrangements.
Will Santa bring Christmas music?
Choose the Christmas music option on your booking request if you would like Santa to bring music and set up for your event. Discuss setup space, power access, volume, and any additional costs with Santa when confirming your visit.
What should I share before the visit?
Share the guest count, children’s ages, planned activities, parking, venue access, and any accessibility needs. Discuss photo arrangements and any gifts with Santa before your event.
